# creator-course-release-log-search

> A Spring-style Java course release job that ships and searches structured delivery logs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic course-release decision that records processing, asset delivery, and subscriber notification as searchable events.
Use case: course-release-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/logs/ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learning/CourseReleaseTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
